usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover which IPSet and Alias names are valid when building firewall rules for a specific VM — these are the values you can reference in the source/destination fields of a rule. Results include both VM-level and datacenter-level references that are in scope for this VM. Requires VM.Audit on the target VM's path; no node-online requirement beyond normal API reachability.

examples.summary: List all firewall references (aliases and IPSets) available for VM 105 on node pve1

tips: Omit the 'type' filter to see all available references in one call; use 'type=alias' or 'type=ipset' when you only need one kind.
The 'scope' field in each result indicates whether the reference is defined at the VM level or inherited from the datacenter/cluster firewall.
Use this before creating or validating firewall rules to confirm the exact 'ref' string to use — rule creation will reject unknown references.
